henry.title: Harvest Barge: Why Does a Steel Ship Float?
henry.intro: A steel block sinks, but a giant steel ship floats. The secret is SHAPE: a hull pushes away lots of water. If the water pushed away weighs more than the boat and its cargo, it floats. Your mission: shape 170 g of clay into a barge that carries the most mini pumpkins to the harvest market!
steps: Open the Harvest Barge sim. Try the clay lump first.
Shape a boat with the sliders and load pumpkins. Predict before each one!
Find the design that carries the most pumpkins, and fill in the worksheet.
Bonus (with a grown-up): build a foil boat and load it with pennies in the sink.
worksheet: Prediction table: for 3 designs, write width, wall height, your guess for max pumpkins, and the real max.
Archimedes' idea in your own words: a floating boat pushes away water that weighs ___.
The lump and the boat are the SAME 170 g of clay. Why does one sink and the other float?
Why did the boat sink when you added one too many pumpkins? Use the words 'average density' and '1.0'.
Sketch your best design. Label width, wall height, and pumpkin count.
Why do walls that are too tall and wide tear? What trade-off did you have to make?
Hands-on bonus: how many pennies did your foil boat hold?
links: Follow the 3 steps: sink the lump, shape a boat, then load pumpkins!
Bonus: why is it autumn in October?

steps: Step 1: Tap Drop the clay lump. Watch it sink, then tap Next.
Step 2: Drag How wide? and How tall are the walls? until the message turns green, then tap Next.
Step 3: Tap ➕ Add pumpkin, guess 👍 or 👎, and watch the Sink-o-meter. When it sinks, tap Try again with a new shape!
0.look: The Sink-o-meter needle moves toward red with each pumpkin. Open 'Show the science numbers' to see the weight and how much water the boat can push away.
0.q: What was your best design (width and height), and how many pumpkins did it carry?

frankie.title: Apples Grow on Trees!
frankie.intro: In fall, farmers pick apples, pumpkins, and chile. Apples grow on trees and have seeds inside!
steps: Play Apple Picking with Curious George.
Draw and count on your worksheet.
worksheet: Draw 3 apples in the basket. Count them: ___
Circle what grows on a tree: 🍎 / 🥕
Draw the seeds inside an apple
How many apples did you get? Draw them!
links: Press the green PLAY arrow and help George pick apples!

steps: 🔢 Find the missing number ❓. Tap that apple!
0.look: Grown-up: read the numbers out loud together, 0, 1, 2...
0.q: How many apples did you get? Draw them!
